# Axis One

> Axis One is capital governance infrastructure operated by AX1 Structura Ltd. It connects committed capital to current milestones, attributable evidence, explicit authority and controlled decision states.

Axis One is non-custodial. It does not hold, transfer, settle, manage or guarantee client capital, and it does not replace the authorised human decision-maker. Public programme interfaces are illustrative and are not customer data.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ax1.capital/): Product position, decision test, governance architecture and Decision Brief.
- [System](https://ax1.capital/system): How execution, evidence, validation, authority and decision records connect.
- [Decision exposure](https://ax1.capital/capital): Directional exposure calculator, methodology and independently attributed industry context.
- [Deployment](https://ax1.capital/deployment): AX1.Pilot, AX1.Core and AX1.Enterprise engagement scopes.
- [Trust](https://ax1.capital/trust): Permissioned access, product boundaries, collaboration model and current security position.
- [Founder](https://ax1.capital/founder): Tania Jokic and the operating problem behind Axis One.

Interactive currency displays support GBP, EUR, USD, CZK, HUF, RSD, AED and SAR. Selecting a currency changes the denomination and formatting only; Axis One does not perform an exchange-rate conversion.

## Company

AX1 Structura Ltd is registered in England and Wales, company number 17151320. Registered office: 66 Paul Street, London EC2A 4NA, England. Contact: info@ax1.capital.

Website enquiry and Decision Brief tools prepare a `mailto:` message in the visitor's browser. They open the visitor's configured email application only after the visitor chooses to do so; the website does not submit or send the message automatically.

For a fuller factual reference, see [llms-full.txt](https://ax1.capital/llms-full.txt).

## Multilingual retrieval

The canonical public website is currently authored in English. The fuller factual reference includes concise, meaning-preserving descriptions in Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Czech, Hungarian, Serbian and Arabic so AI search systems can resolve relevant non-English queries to the same Axis One entity without treating them as separate translated websites.
